_readme: CLASS NOTICES shown on the RCF Classes notices page.
Use these for changes of time, revision announcements, holiday breaks and
similar messages. Delete a notice when it is no longer relevant.
NEVER put a meeting link, a meeting password or a student's name, telephone
number or result in this file. Everything here is published on the internet.
FIELDS:  id, date (e.g. 26 August 2026), title, text (a list of paragraphs),
After editing this file, run build.cmd.
